Its gives defense which reduces damage taken from enemies. It gives HP to take more hits. However at the end of the day, it helps you survive longer, even if it’s only a turn or two, or longer if you’re running a stall comp.

For stall comps, that extra defense to reduce dmg, and hp can help you survive several more turns if you can keep pumping heals and shields to stall for your poison/counter. It’s a uphill battle of hp go down, hp go up, mitigate dmg, take a bit of dmg to apply more Poison/Counter.

For burst comps, it may only provide one or if you’re lucky, two turns. However, that one turn can be the decider between a win or a loss. Since burst comps emphasize dealing as much and fast dmg as possible, the amount of turns needed to clear is much less compared to stall. It’s all about acceleration to kill the enemy before you die. That one turn can be the extra burst dmg you need to finish off the boss. Hence why DR is so delicious(*cough cough* Mouchette *cough cough*). The same can be said about Cetarchon in a way due to enemies hitting harder by 25%.

In stall it can turn 10 turns into 14 turns.

In burst, it can turn 7 turns into 8 turns.

Hence, this is my statement on why Stats are good, for one turn or more.
